why: The data folder doors' refusals (criteria DF17 to DF21), and the refusals of the move's own check, walk and confirm (DF4 and DF16), which the move and confirm doors send with their own codes. Each needs this computer's process table, a real data folder move, a data folder, mark or place in a given state, or a server given no way to start the mover, so no door here can safely meet them: a move here would start a process that stops an office, and a confirm would remove files. tests/the-data-folder-door.test.ts meets each press refusal through the door on a scratch office, whose mover is a process the test starts and stops itself, and some of the move's codes there too. tests/the-data-folder-move.test.ts and tests/a-windows-data-folder-is-never-on-a-network-place.test.ts give each of the move's codes from the mover, and the first checks each code's English against its template in src/config/the-data-folder-move-words.mjs. The stored files' refusal for an unreadable mark is met by tests/a-moved-data-folder-still-shows-its-stored-files.test.ts.
